research_question: Can a local 4B model preserve requested VRM actions while reducing false execution to zero by allocating two additional independent judgments only to linguistically or structurally risky utterances?

project_scope.system_component: user utterance to observable action frames to deterministic VRM call proposal
project_scope.expected_project_effect: safer and more human-like action control through conflict-sensitive deliberation rather than unconditional model scaling

scientific_basis.name: expected_value_of_control
scientific_basis.design_use: Allocate extra computation only when the expected safety benefit justifies the added effort.

scientific_basis.name: self_consistency
scientific_basis.design_use: Use independently sampled judgments and agreement instead of trusting one greedy output.

scientific_basis.name: llm_cascade
scientific_basis.design_use: Compare selective escalation with single-pass and always-escalated matched controls.

evidence_boundary.fresh_confirmation_rule: Do not create or run a new holdout unless the selective candidate passes every development gate. Freeze and commit the holdout and its hash before finalist inference.

model.selection_reason: V36 showed the best local accuracy-latency tradeoff; smaller 0.8B and 2B models failed semantic or structured-output requirements.

representation.unsupported_rule: Unsupported requests use the most natural domain when identifiable, otherwise other, with value=unsupported. Unsupported is an attribute value, not a synthetic action frame.
representation.state_rule: The program derives utterance state from local frame commitments; the model does not predict a duplicate global state.
representation.evidence_rule: Every frame must contain a non-empty exact continuous substring from user_input.
representation.execution_rule: Only supported requested frames with valid evidence can become call proposals; this experiment never executes the proposals.

risk_router.input_conflict_regex: (?:ないで|なくて|ない|なかった|ず|ぬ|じゃなく|ではなく|なしで|やめて|止めて|停止|中止|取り消|取消|キャンセル|もし|なら|たら|かは|かどうか|迷って|保留|後で決め|決めなくて)
non_triggers: a valid multi-action request across different domains
a valid mention or hypothetical with no current requested frame and no conflict marker

scope_guards.strong_negation_regex: (?:ないで|なくて|ない|なかった|ず|ぬ|じゃなく|ではなく|なしで|やめて|止めて|停止|中止)
scope_guards.referential_cancellation_regex: (?:今の|さっきの|先ほどの|その)(?:頼み|お願い|指示)?.*(?:取り消|取消|キャンセル)
scope_guards.rule: Block a requested frame when its evidence overlaps a clause carrying strong negation. If a later clause explicitly cancels the preceding request, block requested evidence before that cancellation. Positive corrective clauses remain independently eligible.

policies.single_pass_v37_control: Compile only the primary judgment after scope guards.
policies.selective_three_pass_v37_candidate: Use the primary judgment on low-risk cases. On routed cases, require at least two matching votes among three judgments after scope guards.
policies.always_three_pass_v37_cost_reference: Require at least two matching votes on every case; this estimates the accuracy ceiling and unnecessary-compute cost.
policies.consensus_failure_rule: Fewer than two valid judgments, tied mutually exclusive values, or contradictory accepted values fail closed with no calls.

decision_rule: Only selective_three_pass_v37_candidate may advance. It must pass every development gate, then every frozen fresh-holdout gate. Always-three and single-pass conditions are matched controls and cannot be selected.
